parts:
Distance 3.5 users:

I have uploaded the following utility to the Distance web site
(http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/). It can be downloaded from the
Distance Support, Updates and Extras page, under Downloads.

Enjoy!

- Len Thomas


GxHisto: A macro for reproducing the detection function hisograms in MS Excel
Contributed by Dr. Tim Gerrodette, Southwest Fisheries Science Center, NMFS.

Distance 3.5 produces high-resolution plots of the detection function g(x)
(and probability density function f(x) for point transects). These plots can
be copied and pasted into word processor packages (using Paste Special) as
pictures. However, these pictures cannot then be edited or formatted. This
macro allows you to recreate the plots from Distance within Microsoft Excel
as MS Charts. These charts can then be reformatted as required. In
addition, the macro can be edited to change the default chart format.

GxHisto is provided free of charge as a service to the Distance user
community. If you have any comments about the macro, please contact Dr. Tim
Gerrodette at ti...@ucsd.edu.
